description: Removes an identified guest already recorded as 13 or older from the selected wedding. Guests under 13 or with unconfirmed ages are ineligible. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

guest_id.description: Identifier of the guest to remove from the selected wedding.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: remove_my_guest
title: Remove Wedding Guest
